critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Upper Deck Hump' geometry by extending its longitudinal length along the fuselage axis to cover 60% of the cockpit-to-wing transition area. Simultaneously, apply a spherical fillet or increase the radius of the leading edge curvature to eliminate sharp angles, and scale the vertical height by a factor of 1.25 relative to the current profile to create a more pronounced, rounded structural bulge.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck hump ends abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the top of the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, angular transition where the upper deck meets the main body.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively flat and low-profile.
discrepancies.reference: A more pronounced, rounded elevation above the cockpit area.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck section appears narrow relative to the fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: A wider, more substantial structural bulge for the upper cabin.
